source: Editorial task: inform passengers about a consultation, not recommend a final route. Two possible night-bus routes are published. Feedback closes 21 January. The committee will choose after reviewing submissions; neither option is approved.

idea.title: Two night-bus options open for passenger comment
idea.description: Build the case for the committee to choose the first route as its final service.
idea.rationale: The options give passengers a basis for feedback before the committee chooses.
idea.evidence: Two possible routes; feedback closes 21 January; neither approved.
